embeds.title: BLHA CONSTITUTION — QUICK REFERENCE
embeds.description:
**Working Draft — Version 1.1**

• **League:** 12-franchise dynasty hockey on Fantrax
• **Format:** H2H Points • Daily lineups • 22-week regular season
• **Schedule:** Every opponent twice • No divisions
• **Active roster:** 20 — 3 C, 3 LW, 3 RW, 3 F, 6 D, 2 G
• **Reserve / Minors / IR:** 6 / 10 / 5
• **Minors:** Age ≤25 as of Sept. 15; skaters ≤100 career NHL GP; goalies ≤50
• **FAAB:** $1,000 • No rollover • $0 bids allowed • Hidden bids • No FCFS
• **Acquisitions:** 5 per normal fantasy week
• **Goalie starts:** 4 normal week • 8 two-week championship
• **Trade deadline:** End of Week 20
• **Annual draft:** 5 rounds • Linear • About 2–3 weeks after NHL Entry Draft
• **Playoffs:** 6 teams • Top 2 byes • Reseed • 2-week championship
• **Dues:** $50 annually • Startup payment $100 to keep franchise one season prepaid
